The '''Neo-Fundamentalist Phlangites''', also known as the '''NFP''', were a group led by the individual [[Zaglis]] that operated in the [[Fioer desert]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zaraksander]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], NFP kidnapped [[Cyrstas Eloinie]], the daughter of the corporate executive [[Darred Eloinie]], during the [[Peaceful Dawn Rally]] and held her hostage. The NFP demanded that Darred pay a ransom of 100,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for her return, and Darred subsequently hired the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Valken Gresh]] to go up against the group and rescue her.
